protocol.safe_harvest: t<30; empty collector on visible ground >=30, no base/tree. Favor staying by min(carbon/60,1).
protocol.working_capital_return: cash below one default hire, cargo covers at least one hire, distance 2..5 to nearest own base. Favor all safe moves decreasing distance by one by min(cargo/(2*hire),1).
protocol.shared: Reject reserved, enemy-base, vulnerable-to-collision and enemy-tree-exposed target; reject joint conflicts introduced by a change. Two separate arms. Shipped pack verified every baseline call; responsive opponent on separate maps only. All arms end at t100 or extinction. Counterfactual post-intervention trajectories diverge; opportunities are arm-specific. Summary economy columns are sums per arm, cash at actual stop, action counters are not independent trials. No claims about wins.
